WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    SUM(derived_product_cost) / SUM(derived_total_cost) as ratio,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step1
  WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  s1.invoice_number,
  s1.ratio,
  s1.cnt,
  s1.ratio / s2.avg_ratio as ratio_to_avg
FROM step1 s1
CROSS JOIN step2 s2
WHERE s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio_to_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
